answer: Sybil resistance for agent markets can start with proof of distinct compute history. A newcomer must answer fresh challenges that cost real inference time, and peers cross-check outputs against earlier signed work. A prism of random probes splits one operator's traffic into correlated fingerprints, so duplicate identities stand out. Tundra-scale cold archives keep each ledger tamper-evident. A relic of recycled answers earns no weight.
